ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward along its lane and collides with the turning vehicle.

adversarials.behavior: The car turns left from the curb lane across the ego vehicle's path onto a side street.

requirements_and_restrictions: Initial positions are defined with both vehicles traveling in the same direction on separate lanes; the scenario terminates upon collision between the ego and the adversarial vehicle.
